pages.title: Carry both dusts
pages.text: Equipment burns Negarite and Posirite Dust together. Heavier module use burns fuel faster.$(br2)Install and enable $(item)Autofeed Power$() to replenish a piece from dust in your inventory or an Energy Holder. Keep both types available. Each piece still needs its own working module setup.

pages.title: Energy Holder
pages.text: Use an Energy Holder in your main hand to open its panel. The arrows move dust in or out.$(br2)Manual mode leaves collection to you. Automatic mode gathers loose fuel dust from your inventory over time.$(br2)Autofeed-equipped gear can use stored dust while the holder stays in your inventory, in either collection mode.
